verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a programmatic path to a deposit account. You create a personal customer as a PROSPECT and activate it, run KYC/KYB verification via the API, then create SAVING/CHECKING demand deposit accounts held with partner banks. A Sandbox with immediate API keys and dedicated KYC/KYB test cases lets the flow be exercised before launch. missing for 10: explicit FDIC/deposit-insurance evidence, documented sandbox-to-production parity guarantees (sandbox KYB is auto-passed), end-to-end application-to-active-account walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration.
